name: What types of interior doors does AKN Design Group install during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: What types of interior doors does AKN Design Group install during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group integrates various interior door styles, including solid core, hollow core, French, barn, and pocket doors, into comprehensive residential renovations. We focus on selecting doors that align with your home's aesthetic and functional needs, whether for noise reduction, space-saving, or enhancing natural light. As part of our design-build process, we ensure door selections complement other elements like trim, flooring, and overall architectural style, contributing to a cohesive whole-home transformation.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group installs various interior door styles, including solid core, hollow core, French, barn, and pocket doors, as part of comprehensive residential renovations.
